steps.en: Install in a compatible Python environment; pin the reviewed version for deployment
steps.zh: 装入兼容的 Python 环境；部署时锁定研究版本
steps.code: uv add contextgem             # or: pip install -U contextgem

steps.en: Create a text Document and declare payment aspects and sentence-referenced anomaly concepts
steps.zh: 创建文本，声明付款条款与带句子引用的异常

steps.en: Configure an approved model endpoint, credentials and request limits
steps.zh: 配置获准模型端点、凭据与请求限制

steps.en: Build model requests, validate answers and reconnect source references; report unresolved failures
steps.zh: 构造模型请求，校验答案并关联来源；报告未解决失败

steps.en: Read the extracted items and inspect their supporting source objects
steps.zh: 读取抽取结果，并检查其来源对象

steps.en: Validate meaning on your corpus; persist results and failed-job state in your application
steps.zh: 用自己的语料验证含义；在应用中保存结果和失败任务状态

value.en: Typed document findings with inspectable source locations, without rebuilding prompt and reference plumbing
value.zh: 拿到有类型且可检查来源位置的文档结果，不必重复搭提示词与引用关联逻辑
